profiles.label: Family-friendly experiences

delivery.Food & beverage: Offer early sittings, adaptable portions, and space for shared family visits.
delivery.Retail: Offer durable products, parent-and-child workshops, and convenient browsing times.
delivery.Hospitality: Offer connecting-room options, practical family amenities, and short local activities.
delivery.Wellness: Offer caregiver-friendly timetables and adaptable sessions without promising health outcomes.
delivery.Entertainment: Offer daytime sessions, clear age guidance, and options for adults and children to participate together.

signals: shared activities that adults and children can choose together
short sessions and predictable booking windows
clear pricing and easier group planning

profiles.label: Calm and intentional routines

delivery.Food & beverage: Keep the menu focused and offer quieter reservation windows and an unhurried service rhythm.
delivery.Retail: Emphasize product care, tactile discovery, and a calmer appointment-based shopping option.
delivery.Hospitality: Prioritize quiet spaces, optional activities, and room to set an individual pace.
delivery.Wellness: Provide low-stimulation sessions and clear choices about intensity, timing, and participation.
delivery.Entertainment: Offer smaller groups, lower-volume sessions, and clear sensory information before booking.

signals: a repeatable experience with fewer competing demands
clear sensory choices and quieter participation options

profiles.label: Design and creative discovery

delivery.Food & beverage: Pair the menu with local creative collaborations, listening sessions, and a rotating visual identity.
delivery.Retail: Spotlight independent designers, limited product editions, and hands-on making sessions.
delivery.Hospitality: Include a small creative workspace and opt-in visits hosted by local artists or designers.
delivery.Wellness: Build a visually considered environment with expressive movement and peer-led creative sessions.
delivery.Entertainment: Invite local artists to shape original experiences and give guests a role in the creative process.

signals: introductions to small local creators and their work
making or shaping part of the experience
a coherent visual and sensory identity

profiles.label: Practical value and access

delivery.Food & beverage: Use transparent set menus, a smaller operating footprint, and clearly priced group options.
delivery.Retail: Offer transparent price bands, repair-first options, and useful pre-owned products.
delivery.Hospitality: Focus on compact rooms, practical amenities, and clear optional extras.
delivery.Wellness: Offer shorter sessions, straightforward pricing, and a low-commitment introductory pass.
delivery.Entertainment: Offer clear ticket bundles, shorter formats, and affordable group booking options.

signals: clear inclusions and predictable total costs
small first purchases or introductory bookings
a useful experience without unnecessary extras

profiles.label: Flexible working-day routines

delivery.Food & beverage: Build around predictable service windows, advance ordering, and bookable after-work gatherings.
delivery.Retail: Offer focused selections, appointment-based advice, and convenient collection windows.
delivery.Hospitality: Include reliable workspaces, flexible arrival times, and a clear separation between work and rest.
delivery.Wellness: Offer time-boxed sessions, flexible booking, and practical routines that fit between commitments.
delivery.Entertainment: Offer concise evening formats, clear start times, and simple group reservations.

signals: bookable experiences with a clear duration
advance booking and practical cancellation options

profiles.label: Exploration and novel experiences

delivery.Food & beverage: Rotate unusual tasting themes and guest producers, with clear explanations of every new offering.
delivery.Retail: Offer rotating collections, maker stories, and small discovery events that invite exploration.
delivery.Hospitality: Build locally hosted itineraries and optional neighborhood experiences beyond the usual checklist.
delivery.Wellness: Offer introductory sessions in unfamiliar practices with clear guidance and adaptable participation.
delivery.Entertainment: Rotate interactive themes, surprise showcases, and optional routes through each experience.

signals: rotating themes and opportunities to try something unfamiliar
introductions hosted by neighborhood businesses or creators
clear context that makes unfamiliar choices approachable

profiles.label: Open audience brief

delivery.Food & beverage: Use the supplied audience brief to frame a small tasting pilot and gather direct feedback.
delivery.Retail: Use the audience brief to choose a small initial product range and test it with prospective shoppers.
delivery.Hospitality: Use the audience brief to prototype a stay package and interview prospective guests.
delivery.Wellness: Use the audience brief to prototype session formats and ask participants about timing and access needs.
delivery.Entertainment: Use the audience brief to test a small event format and gather participant feedback.

signals: direct conversations about the supplied audience brief
a limited trial before committing to a permanent format
changes based on what participants actually report
